name: loudtzu-actors-mcp
description: 9 tools: Canadian building permits, federal corporations, recalls, charities, funding programs and retail prices (Best Buy CA, Loblaw banners, any Shopify/WooCommerce store).
long_description: Runs LOUDTZU's public Apify Actors with your own Apify API token. Each call is billed by Apify on your account at the Actor's pay-per-event price (shown in each tool description). A per-call cost cap (default $1) is applied. Not affiliated with or endorsed by Apify, Best Buy, Loblaw, Shopify, WooCommerce or any government body.

apify_token.title: Apify API token
apify_token.description: Your own token from console.apify.com > Settings > API & Integrations. Charges bill to this account.

max_charge_usd.title: Max charge per call (USD)
max_charge_usd.description: Hard cap on Actor charges for one tool call.
